entities.name: Ageas Federal Life Insurance Company Limited

industry: Financial Services > Banks > Private Sector Bank

operating_notes.text: CASA plus deposits under ₹3 Cr were 85% of total deposits at Mar-26, up from 81% a year ago.
Top-20 borrowers were 7.38% of the portfolio at Q4FY26, down from 10.32% at Q4FY24.
Remittance market share was 19.72% in 9mFY26, up from 18.42% in FY23.
Q4FY26 cost of funds was 5.46%, with the bank deliberately reducing high-value deposits.
CASA ratio 32.94% (up 271 bps YoY) and NR deposits ₹1,02,619.69 Cr (up 7.04% QoQ).
Board approved entering into a deed of assignment to acquire a select portfolio of retail credit cards from Standard Chartered Bank, India on 30 April 2026.
Q4FY26 total business stood at ₹5,78,959 Cr, with CASA crossing ₹1 lakh crore and NRE deposits crossing ₹1 lakh crore.
Postal ballot record date 30-04-2026 with 8,46,956 shareholders on record; public institutions polled 82.2% of their shares.
Consolidated deposits were ₹3,42,189 Cr and advances ₹3,12,823 Cr at Sep-2026.
Retail banking segment result (net of provisions) was ₹895.36 Cr in Q2FY27 against ₹321.13 Cr a year earlier.
The switch to fair value accounting for stock options cut Q2FY27 post-tax profit by ₹29.61 Cr.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): interest earned ₹7,946.61 Cr (+11.8% YoY), net profit ₹1,393.25 Cr (+25.7% YoY).
Q4FY26 investor presentation (consolidated): net profit ₹1,259 Cr (+22% YoY), NII ₹3,173 Cr (+33% YoY) including ₹456 Cr IT-refund interest; GNPA 1.62%, NNPA 0.20%.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): net profit ₹1,259.10 Cr (+20.93% QoQ), GNPA 1.62%, NNPA 0.20%, NIM 3.74%, CASA and NR deposits each above ₹1 lakh crore.
Board approved proceeding to enter into a deed of assignment with Standard Chartered Bank India to acquire a select retail credit card portfolio.
29 April 2026: Federal Bank reported Q4 FY26 net profit of ₹1,145 Cr on total business of ₹5,78,959 Cr, with GNPA improving to 1.62% and CASA ratio reaching 32.94%.
On May 06, 2026, Federal Bank received RBI approval for Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited to acquire up to 9.99% of its paid-up share capital or voting rights.

2026-06-04: Shareholders passed all three postal ballot resolutions — Harsh Dugar's re-appointment as Executive Director and FY2024-25 variable pay for former MD & CEO Shyam Srinivasan and former ED Shalini Warrier — with over 99% in favour.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): interest earned ₹8,382.84 Cr (+16.2% YoY), net profit ₹1,564.06 Cr (+53.4% YoY).
Federal Bank published the transcript of its Q2FY27 earnings call on October 16, 2026.
Federal Bank clarified to the stock exchange regarding news on its acquisition stance.
